issues: Original fifth-house/children introduction is substantive but UNNUMBERED; do not increment the printed chapter counter. Subsequent printed CXXXVIII count starts late original PDF638.
All original source claims about pregnancy, infertility, abortion, miscarriage, child birth, child health and child death are unsupported historical hypotheses and must not inform care or prognosis.
Fifth house is expressly prioritized over contrary eleventh testimony in both favorable and adverse cases. Do not interpret eleventh as equivalent source weight.
When fifth and eleventh are empty, author falls back to Lord fifth, and when several sources disagree he urges a nonnumeric majority of testimonies.
Jupiter Venus Moon and North Node are source fruitful labels, Saturn Mars Sun and South Node barren; these are NOT scientific reproductive indicators.
Mercury is explicitly neutral/convertible depending on aspects, conjunction, essential dignity and oriental/occidental status, preventing a simple Mercury=fertility or Mercury=infertility rule.
Planet strength and sign fruitfulness interact, and mixed fertile/barren arrangements are said to be mediocrity or require other testimonies, not unqualified positive or negative outcomes.
The original printed fifth-lord negative passage can mean no children, few children and possibly uncertain survival; syntactic wording about living children is ambiguous and not repaired.
Planetary and zodiac glyphs and mutual terms on original PDF638 are not fully transcribed, and cannot enter executable reproductive rules.
Original source attributes multiple further aphorisms to Alubater, Schoner and Origanus page 640; original author-to-author collation not done.
Period statements about children's temperament or welfare are not evidence of a real child's personality, disability or health.
Several high-stakes branches switch freely from few children to no children, infertility, infant death, or even death of the native; outcomes are scientifically noninterchangeable.
Lilly's personally observed Jupiter retrograde in fifth but no children is a single retrospective anecdote, not replicated prospective evidence.
No verified birth certificates, repeated parent/child records, obstetric data, denominators, controls or blinded predictions were used in this lane.
Even if original planet placements are eventually computed, actuarial/clinical fertility and death probabilities cannot be inferred without independent validated data and appropriate safeguards.
The packet is selective original-source anchoring and qualified paraphrase rather than original diplomatic glyph-by-glyph printed edition.
